name: agenda-ba-eletrica
description: Agenda Corporativa | Agenda BA — sistema de agendamento de reuniões para rede local

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @agenda/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @agenda/api" "npm run dev -w @agenda/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @agenda/shared && npm run build -w @agenda/api && npm run build -w @agenda/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @agenda/shared && npm run typecheck -w @agenda/api && npm run typecheck -w @agenda/web && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit
